notes:
Replication values are author-derived primary project-table values, not independently converted. Original p.637 Table 2 visually verified; exact target pairwise N unprinted, so n is null. Original and replication tests are separately reported as printed. No individual narrative success verdict located; numeric success coding is not treated as narrative. Ozer and Benet-Martinez (2006) summarized the prospective associations between childhood personality and adulthood success, but the replication study can only test concurrent associations between adulthood personality and success.
Completion source review (n_r): Table 1 explicitly lists one test and its replication sample size. No arithmetic or recruitment-total substitution.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Printed observed effect .31, corrected effect .32 retained in notes. Generic printed metric retained; r versus standardized coefficient is not independently distinguishable per row. No metric or sign conversion.
Completion source review (pval_value_r): Explicit two-tailed p < .05 success definition and 100% success for exactly one test establish same-test bound. Exact p not supplied.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly label column replication success rate, observed/corrected 100/100. Observed author summary mapped to successful; corrected summary retained in notes. No new significance-based verdict.
